appraisal_events.evidence: Je ne peux pas vous dire comme Mme Blandais m'agace en regardant ces gens-là comme cela [...] Je voudrais pouvoir lui donner une gifle. C'est comme cela qu'on donne de l'importance à cette canaille
appraisal_events.explanation: The bâtonnier scolds Mme Blandais for staring at the costumed guests, framing her curiosity as a ridiculous social faux pas; the narrator presents this hyperbolic complaint satirically as part of the group's petty status anxieties.

status_effects.explanation: Being publicly scolded by the bâtonnier as ridiculous and undignified locally diminishes Mme Blandais's standing within her own coterie, though the satirical framing keeps the judgment mild and comic.
